headline: The scan report now records how many colour groups a clip has, so the palette question can be answered with a measurement
notes: **The scan report now carries a colour-groups line.** The row colour is an index into an eight-colour list, wrapped — so a clip with nine distinct repeated portions would paint two unrelated portions the same hue, which is the one direction it is expensive to be wrong in. Nobody knew whether real projects ever reach nine; a 21-use showreel reached seven. The panel now records the highest it has seen in a session and prints it in the report, so a ninth colour gets designed when a real report asks for one, and not before. A count only — never a clip name, a sequence or a path.
